name: Star Factory
storyline: Welcome to your new job at the Star Factory! Here in the endless oblivion of the void, you will be tasked with the harrowing ordeal of creating entire stars from scratch!
summary:
A Peaceful, Skyblock-Style Questing Modpack.

This modpack revolves around very few mods. The most notable ones being Astral Sorcery and Extra Utilities 2. You start with infinite wells of four resources, and you must progress using a progression system based around what resources are available to you. Eventually, with enough automation, you will be able to craft the ultimate goal, stars.
